label: Second Vatican Council, Dei Verbum §19…… supports Every one of the five reported commissions…
note: Dei Verbum 19 asserts that the four Gospels faithfully hand on what Jesus really did and taught. Reading this as: every power named in each of the five commission reports was given (or promised) by Jesus, is the analyst's; the council speaks of the Gospels generally and of their substance, not of each named power.
